svg.title: Yano X master architecture
svg.desc: Clients submit signed messages to a Yano node. The Yano host admits, pools, proposes, re-executes and finalizes app blocks with peer members, commits authenticated state, runs effects and anchors roots on Cardano. Yano X runtime plugin bundles loaded through the plugin catalog provide the state machines, composites, connectors, bridge and read models. Libraries, tools and the JVM distribution are built in this repository.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How a Yano X app ledger runs end to end: the Yano host (bloxbean/yano), the Yano X JVM runtime plugins loaded into it, and the libraries, tools and distribution built in this repository.
